Title: Findings tab shows summary, table, and filters
Preconditions: Log in to AI Defense as an Admin or Owner. Register a code-scan MCP server named Findings Multi from public repo https://github.com/fiyaznafa/mcp-code-scan-fixtures, branch main, subfolder /mcp_servers/evals/findings-tab/multi-findings, with scan turned on. Wait until the scan completes. In Settings, Supply Chain Profiles, open the MCP Scanning profile and confirm the rules you expect are enabled. Wait until the scan completes. In Settings, Supply Chain Profiles, open the MCP Scanning profile and confirm the rules you expect are enabled. Open AI Inventory, open Findings Multi, and stay on that server.
Steps: 1. Call GET /v1/mcp/servers/{server_id}/findings?capability_name=get_escalation_policies. 2. Call it again with severity=HIGH. 3. Call it with search set to a known capability name fragment. 4. Call it with group_by=severity. 5. Call it with group_by=capability. 6. Call it with group_by=finding.
Expected Result: capability_name returns only that exact capability. severity=HIGH returns only HIGH items. search matches capability name or finding name, or an exact finding ID. group_by=severity returns groups whose key is CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW and whose label is the title-case word, ordered Critical then High then Medium then Low. group_by=capability returns a key, the capability name as label, capabilityType, and totalCount. group_by=finding returns the sub-technique id as key and the finding name as label, in label order. Empty groups are omitted. lastScannedAt is the same on every call.

Title: Another tenant cannot read these findings
Preconditions: Use Findings Multi from the first tenant. Also have an API token for a different tenant that cannot see that server.
Steps: 1. From the other tenant, call GET /v1/mcp/servers/{server_id}/findings with the first tenant's server id. 2. Call GET /v1/mcp/servers/{server_id}/findings/{finding_id} with a real finding ID from the first tenant.
Expected Result: Both calls return HTTP 404. The response does not include capability names, finding names, or finding IDs from the first tenant.
